reviewed_by: Claude review of subagent reasoning-level selection
reason: Subagents always ran at the provider model's default reasoning level: neither start tool took a level and the child request never carried one, so a parent set to high delegated at the default. The selected files cover both parents end to end. A provider parent's child inherits the conversation's level, an explicit level overrides it, an unknown level is refused without a child, and the start result and list view report the level. A harness parent's child inherits the harness session's level, takes an explicit override through the gateway schema, and keeps the model default under a vendor-only level. A goal continuing on late reports now sends the conversation's current level (the new goal test fails on the old code with None). The remaining cases in both files guard the unchanged start, wait, stop, restart and delivery paths that the changed start and continuation code runs through.
exclusions: No frontend, Playwright, native or production-build gates apply: the UI does not read the new view field, and the operator settings, persistence schema (one optional record field, no migration) and packaging are unchanged. test_chat_goals.py is excluded because chat.py's own goal continuation is untouched; its subagent-report sibling is covered by the new case. test_harnesses.py and test_harness_adapters.py are excluded because the harness change is limited to the subagent.start gateway schema and pass-through, which the selected harness subagent file exercises. Full suites and live provider calls are excluded.
